title: Single-cell transcriptomic atlas of the human fetal uveal tract reveals heterogeneity in melanocyte populations.
snippet: Uveal melanocytes are neural crest-derived cells contributing to ocular pigmentation, yet their developmental heterogeneity and microenvironmental roles remain poorly characterized. We present a single-cell transcriptomic atlas of the human fetal uveal tract, profiling 81,603 cells across 14 cell types from eight eyes at 12 and 20 post-conception weeks. Amo...
